method_allowlist.rationale: The upstream service definition also declares model-control and shared-memory RPCs. The Gateway wrapper never calls them and the Triton server runs with model-control-mode=none.
method_allowlist.enforcement: scripts/run-supply-chain.sh greps the Gateway sources for forbidden RPC symbols and fails the gate if any appears
